caption: A dog runs across a sunlit lawn, and its shadow runs along the grass beside it.

sa.check: A dog runs across a lawn.
The dog's shadow is visible on the grass.
The shadow runs along beside the dog.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps pace with the dog, moving when it moves and in the same direction.
pc.fail: The shadow lags behind or runs ahead; or it stays still while the dog runs; or it moves the opposite way.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the dog's outline, its legs moving in step with the dog's.
pc.fail: The shadow is a different animal's shape; or its legs are still while the dog's move; or it splits into two.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the side of the dog away from the sun and is attached at the paws.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or it is detached from the paws on flat ground; or it switches sides while the sun stays put.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves while the dog stands still; or it changes length with the dog still; or it drifts across the grass by itself.

pc.expect: One dog and one shadow of it; the dog keeps its parts and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The dog duplicates or vanishes; or a second shadow appears under one sun; or the shadow becomes a solid object; or the dog passes through a fence.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The dog's coat and the lawn stay the same, and the shadow stays dark rather than coloured.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour; or the shadow turns bright or coloured; or the lawn's texture changes.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the shadow's relation to it is.
